description: Grouping of related controls; selection and events belong to the child components.

howToUse: Use it to join buttons that act on the same thing, such as align left, center and right, or zoom out and zoom in.
Give the group a `label` that names the set ("Text alignment").
When one button stays marked as active, control it with `activeIndex` and `onActiveIndexChange`.
Use `orientation="vertical"` in toolbars on the side of the screen.
alternatives: Choosing one value for a form: Segmented or RadioGroup.
Turning several options on and off: ToggleGroup.

keyboard.action: Moves from one button of the group to the next.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Visual axis of the set of actions.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the action group.

props.name: defaultActiveIndex
props.description: Initial active index. The group keeps a single active option.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback called when the value changes.
